title: Patch: every Meditative+ and Training Grounds card drawn as what it is: a scene of its own for each, richer the rarer
notes: Part of #3330's per-set picture passes. Every Meditative+ entry (#1–#26 and its seven tokens) and every Training Grounds entry (#1–#60 and the Golem token) draws a scene recipe of its own from its brief in the issue's table, base and Radiant, in its family's look: Meditative+ in ink wash, layered peaks in mist under one red seal, Training Grounds in the carved-wood yard. Each clears its rarity's detail floor and leaves ART_DETAIL_SHORT. Every Unit is a figure-kit character, never the generic traveller, the kits growing by the parts the briefs name; a recipe may draw a crowd of other figures and fade a ghost or a copy, and a recipe with neither draws as before (R3393000). The yard painter draws only a card with no recipe. A Legacy card draws a scene of its own with its yard touch, wearing its Core card's frozen emblem, still one picture, never its Core card's scene (R3393001). No other set's picture moves. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Meditative+ and Training Grounds drawn as scenes
changes: Every Meditative+ and Training Grounds card now shows a whole scene of its own, more detailed the rarer the card: Meditative+ in ink wash among misty peaks, Training Grounds in the yard.
Each Legacy card now has a scene of its own in the yard, and still wears its Core card's emblem.
